versions.content: Development according to the AUTOSAR Generic Structure Template document Type: valid Description: The ECU Configuration Description shall be developed according to the AUTOSAR Generic Structure Template. Rationale: The experience and tools already available for the AUTOSAR Modeling shall be reused. Use Case: The template for the ECU Configuration is similar to other templates already done within AUTOSAR. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: AUTOSAR Generic Structure Template [6]
